questions.question: Maitreya said that the royal dynasty of which king is worthy to serve the pure devotees, the family in which Vidura was born?
questions.explanation: "The royal dynasty of King Puru is worthy to serve the pure devotees because all the descendants of that family are devoted to the Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.8.1)

questions.question: The Bhagavata Purana was directly spoken to the great sages by whom?
questions.explanation: "Let me now begin speaking on the Bhagavata Purana, which was directly spoken to the great sages by the Personality of Godhead..." (SB 3.8.2)

questions.question: From whom did Sanat-kumara, chief of the boy-saints, inquire about the truths regarding Vasudeva?

options.text: Lord Sankarsana, who is seated at the bottom of the universe

questions.explanation: "...Sanat-kumara, the chief of the boy-saints, accompanied by other great sages, inquired exactly like you about the truths regarding Vasudeva, the Supreme, from Lord Sankarsana, who is seated at the bottom of the universe." (SB 3.8.3)

questions.question: Upon whom was Lord Sankarsana meditating, whom the learned esteem as Lord Vasudeva?
questions.explanation: "At that time Lord Sankarsana was meditating upon His Supreme Lord, whom the learned esteem as Lord Vasudeva..." (SB 3.8.4)

questions.question: After Sankarsana spoke Srimad-Bhagavatam to Sanat-kumara, Sanat-kumara explained it when inquired of by which muni?
questions.explanation: "Sanat-kumara also, in his turn, when inquired of by Sankhyayana Muni, explained Srimad-Bhagavatam as he had heard it from Sankarsana." (SB 3.8.7)

questions.question: When the great sage Sankhyayana was describing the glories of the Lord, which two personalities heard him?
questions.explanation: "...it so happened that my spiritual master, Parasara, and Brhaspati both heard him." (SB 3.8.8)

questions.question: When the three worlds were submerged in water, Garbhodakasayi Visnu was lying alone on which bedstead?
questions.explanation: "...Garbhodakasayi Visnu was alone, lying on His bedstead, the great snake Ananta..." (SB 3.8.10)

questions.question: For how long did the Lord lie down in His internal potency, appearing to sleep within the water?

options.text: A thousand cycles of four yugas

questions.explanation: "The Lord lay down for a thousand cycles of four yugas in His internal potency, and by His external energy He appeared to be sleeping within the water." (SB 3.8.12)

questions.question: As the living entities came out for development of their fruitive activities, the Lord saw His transcendental body as what color?
questions.explanation: "...He saw His transcendental body as bluish." (SB 3.8.12)

questions.question: The subtle form of creation, agitated by the mode of passion, pierced through which part of the Lord?
questions.explanation: "The subtle subject matter of creation, on which the Lord's attention was fixed, was agitated by the material mode of passion, and thus the subtle form of creation pierced through His abdomen." (SB 3.8.13)

questions.question: The sum total form of fruitive activity took the shape of what, generated from the Personality of Visnu?

options.text: The bud of a lotus flower

questions.explanation: "Piercing through, this sum total form of the fruitive activity of the living entities took the shape of the bud of a lotus flower generated from the Personality of Visnu..." (SB 3.8.14)

questions.question: Who was generated when the universal lotus flower was impregnated with all the modes of material nature?

options.text: The personality of Vedic wisdom, the self-born

questions.explanation: "...the personality of Vedic wisdom, whom we call the self-born, was generated." (SB 3.8.15)

questions.question: How did Brahma achieve four heads while moving his eyes in all directions?

options.text: In terms of the four directions

questions.explanation: "He therefore circumambulated all of space, and while moving his eyes in all directions he achieved four heads in terms of the four directions." (SB 3.8.16)

questions.question: Searching to trace the origin of the lotus, Brahma entered the water through what?

options.text: The channel of the stem of the lotus

questions.explanation: "Lord Brahma, thus contemplating, entered the water through the channel of the stem of the lotus." (SB 3.8.19)

questions.question: Unable to trace the root, Brahma came back to the top of the lotus and finally realized the Supreme Lord by what means?

options.text: By looking into the stem of the lotus
By concentrating his mind on the Supreme Lord

questions.explanation: "Thus, controlling all objectives, he concentrated his mind on the Supreme Lord." (SB 3.8.21)

questions.question: At the end of how many years of Brahma's meditation could he see the Supreme within his own heart?
questions.explanation: "At the end of Brahma's one hundred years, when his meditation was complete, he developed the required knowledge, and as a result he could see in his heart the Supreme within himself..." (SB 3.8.22)

questions.question: On whose body, like a lotuslike white bedstead, did Brahma see the Personality of Godhead lying alone on the water?
questions.explanation: "Brahma could see that on the water there was a gigantic lotuslike white bedstead, the body of Sesa-naga, on which the Personality of Godhead was lying alone." (SB 3.8.23)

questions.question: The gold on the summit of the coral mountain was mocked by what feature of the Lord?
questions.explanation: "There is gold on the summit of the mountain, but the Lord's helmet, bedecked with jewels, mocked it." (SB 3.8.24)

questions.question: Brahma saw the Lord's chest decorated with which marking and a necklace of unlimited value?
questions.explanation: "His chest was decorated with the srivatsa marking and a necklace of unlimited value." (SB 3.8.28)

questions.question: After being surcharged with the mode of passion and inclined to create, Brahma offered prayers after seeing how many causes of creation?
questions.explanation: "...after seeing the five causes of creation indicated by the Personality of Godhead, he began to offer his respectful prayers on the path of the creative mentality." (SB 3.8.33)

questions.question: Sanat-Kumara accompanied by great sages inquired from ________ about truths regarding the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
Parasara and Brahaspati both heard the glories of Srimad-Bhagavatam from ________.
The Lord lay down for ______ thousand yuga cycles in His internal potency.
Brahma could realize the Supreme Lord_________.

options.text: By seeing into the eternal time
By looking into the stem of the lotus flower
By concentrating his mind on the Supreme Lord
